body.en: Read “History” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. Part type: swing / pendulum cylinder seal kit. Sizes: φ60 / φ70 / φ80 / φ90. This row is φ60. Unit: set. Material and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ60 is also a swing-arm ball diameter on another page. The ball is not this seal. Stop when the printed fragment stops.

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Patent history”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write swing-cylinder seal φ60 and the quantity in sets. The φ60 swing-cylinder seal is a set for the swing or pendulum cylinder on an S-valve concrete pump, supplied from Xingtai. The catalogue does not name which published pump uses φ60. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
